hook.say: Snowy peaks, a legendary train and sleighs on a frozen lake. Five questions on Turkey's wild east!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which eastern city is known for skiing on Mount Palandöken?
questions.say: Which eastern city is known for skiing on Mount Palan-duh-ken?
questions.fact: Erzurum hosted the Winter Universiade in 2011.
questions.sayAnswer: Erzurum! It hosted the Winter Universiade in 2011.

questions.q: The Eastern Express train runs from Ankara to which city?
questions.say: The Eastern Express train runs from Ankara to which city?
questions.fact: The scenic ride covers over 1,300 km and takes about a day.
questions.sayAnswer: Kars! The scenic ride covers more than 1300 kilometres and takes about a day.

questions.q: What is unusual about the water of Lake Van?
questions.say: What is unusual about the water of Lake Van?
questions.fact: Lake Van has no outlet, so salts and soda build up in its water.
questions.sayAnswer: It is salty soda water! Lake Van has no outlet, so salts and soda build up in its water.

questions.q: İshak Pasha Palace stands above which town near Mount Ararat?
questions.say: Is-hak Pasha Palace stands above which town near Mount Ararat?
questions.fact: The palace was completed in 1784, close to the Iranian border.
questions.sayAnswer: Doh-oo-bye-yazit! The palace was completed in 1784, close to the Iranian border.

questions.q: On which frozen lake do horse-drawn sleighs glide every winter?
questions.say: On which frozen lake do horse-drawn sleighs glide every winter?
questions.fact: Lake Çıldır, between Kars and Ardahan, lies nearly 2,000 m high.
questions.sayAnswer: Lake Chil-dir! It lies between Kars and Ardahan, nearly 2000 meters high.
